resources.string: This phone has no web browser. When an app wants to open a sign-in page, Login Relay sends it to your computer, and you sign in there.
Connect this phone to your computer and run the command below. The sign-in page will open there.
The sign-in page is open in your computer\'s browser. When you finish, you\'ll come back to the app here.
Run the command again to continue signing in.
